title: Daybreak
mood: Intimate verses opening into a hopeful chorus
production: Natural room sound, warm and spacious
harmonies: Light stacked harmonies in the chorus
instruments: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, piano, upright bass

sections.name: verse
sections.lyrics:
Morning spills across the floor
I leave my worries by the door
sections.direction: Solo guitar, close vocal, very soft piano

sections.name: chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let the daylight carry me
Into all that I can be
sections.direction: Brushed drums and upright bass enter; open stereo harmonies
